meta.triageRationale: Approved small bugfix (issue -> build): one function in vscode-plugin/src/chat/docs-review-panel.ts lacks the monotonic guard its sibling refreshPending already has.

body.focus: Fix ISSUE-605c70574633ed67: opening two documents quickly in the docs-review pane can display the wrong one, because openDoc has no supersede guard (refreshSeq covers only refreshPending). A slower earlier open must never overwrite a newer one.
body.summary: openDoc in the docs-review pane now carries the same monotonic supersede guard refreshPending has, on its own counter, so a slow earlier open (or its failure) can no longer replace the document the reviewer opened last; a failure of the current open still posts blocked:true. Four regression tests added; four mutations of the guard each turn them red.
